sentences.text: Through:
Mr  versus  THE STATE (GOVT. OF NCT OF DELHI) .....Respon
Through: Ms.Priyanka Dalal, APP for th  alongwith SI Sneh Singh and   Poonam Rani, P.S.-Gokulpuri

CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  ORDER % 09.05.2025 1.
This hearing has been done through hybrid mode.

2. The present petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks the following prayers:-
"a) Quash the impugned order dated 05.10.2023 passed in SC No.37/2020 in case titled as "State Versus Mohd Shakil @ Sonu" in FIR No.509/2018, P.S: Gokulpuri,
u/s 376/506 IPC by the court - of Shri Sandeep Gupta, Ld. ASJ (SC-RC), -East District, Karkardooma Court, Delhi in the interest of Justice.
b) Pass any other or further order(s) as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the given facts and circumstances of the case."

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks leave to withdraw the present petition with liberty to take the contentions taken in the present petition during the course of the trial and in accordance with law.
